_comment: How an inflicted tempest climbs the tiers, dial by dial (design 5.2).
Difficulty you can answer: a lightning rod grounds any bolt within its reach and nothing here changes
that, so copper on the roof is the whole answer whatever was bought. `often` (how often bolts come),
`blast` (how big a crater one digs) and `fire` (how much it sets alight). Harmful throughout.
